capabilities: Save a draft of the current note with an auto-generated or manual summary
Diff the note against any earlier draft with strikethrough for removed words
Restore an earlier draft after saving the current text
List passages removed in earlier drafts with a copy button
Store drafts in a .history or _history folder that moves with the note
extras: The README details limits with Obsidian Sync: hidden folders are not synced, visible _history drafts can appear in search and graph unless excluded, and concurrent saves from two devices can conflict. Also mentions a companion command-line tool sharing the same draft format.
problem: Obsidian has no user-facing way to save and compare drafts of a note, so earlier versions and removed passages are hard to get back.

relations.evidence: Turn on Sync drafts with Obsidian Sync and new notes keep their drafts in a visible _history
Drafts use the same format as the Pentimento command-line tool, so you can use either

summary: Draft-history plugin that saves snapshots of a note, diffs them against the current text, restores earlier drafts, and lists passages you cut.
